Master '''Hornwell''' and his wife keep an estate of [[House Trakand]] in [[Andor]]. Master Hornwell is stout and gray-haired. Mistress Hornwell is a little less round and less gray than her husband, but resembles him a lot.
==Activities==
The Hornwell family welcome Elayne and her company to the estate and accommodate them after they escape from the [[Kin]]'s [[Farm]] attacked by the [[Seanchan]].
